title: Quality management and supplier audits | Aquemi
meta: How our quality management system controls changes, nonconformances, traceability, calibration and suppliers, and how to audit it before you order.
headline: Audit our quality system before you award
lead: Our quality management system, the record each process leaves, and how to audit it before you order.

items.q: What is in the questionnaire pack?
items.a: From [quality system ready for audit, date]: our questionnaire or yours, procedure list, certification status and organization chart. Aquemi-written specimen records: a nonconformance, its corrective and preventive action, and a change request. Onboarding papers and their status are on our buying page.

items.q: Will you sign our quality agreement?
items.a: We return a mark-up within [quality agreement mark-up turnaround, working days]. Send it with your request for proposal. Changes to parts, materials or software you approved: notice per [change notification to clients: scope and notice].
[role that releases to ship, and its independence]. Nothing ships with an open nonconformance report (NCR) on a product-contact part unless you approved its disposition.

items.q: What should we ask any Purified Water supplier?
items.a: Five things make proposals comparable. The document index, with who writes and who signs each document. A factory acceptance test (FAT) that runs the system on water. The record kept for each product-contact joint. Access to audit the quality system before you order. A list of each data integrity requirement and the control that meets it.
